{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_count)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Confirm the QA orders are not real
print("QA order revenue values:", qa_orders['revenue'].unique())"}
